message.text:
h11.

**1st: `store.User` (~6 packages outside the store layer, 7 if you count the API test-helper package); 2nd: `store.Memo` (~4 non-test packages, 6 counting test packages).**

`store.User` is defined at `store/user.go:29` and referenced from:

- `server/router/api/v1` — by far the heaviest consumer, 16 non-test files
- `server/auth` — 2 files (`authenticator.go`, `token.go`)
- `server/notification` — `email.go`, e.g. `displayNameForEmail(user *store.User)` at line 270
- `server/router/fileserver` — the avatar path, `getUserByUsername` returning `*store.User`
- `server/router/rss`
- `server/router/api/v1/test` — test-support package
- (plus `server/router/frontend`, but only in `frontend_test.go`, which is why it drops out of the non-test count)

`store.Memo` is defined at `store/memo.go:35` and referenced from `server/router/api/v1` (12 non-test files), `server/notification`, `server/router/rss`, and `server/runner/memopayload`, plus `server/router/api/v1/test` and `server/router/frontend` in test files only.

Third place is `store.Attachment` (`store/attachment.go:16`) at 3 non-test packages: `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/fileserver`, and `server/router/rss`. Below that, `store.Inbox` and `store.MemoShare` sit at 2 and 1-2 respectively, and `store.MemoRelation` is confined to `server/router/api/v1` alone.

Method note: I counted distinct directories (Go packages) outside `store/**` containing a `store.<Type>` reference in non-generated Go source, treating `proto/gen` as excluded. A couple of entity types score zero on this measure — `store.UserSetting`, `store.InstanceSetting`, and `store.IdentityProvider` — not because they're unused, but because callers outside the data layer work with the protobuf forms (`storepb.UserSetting`, `storepb.IdentityProvider`) rather than the store structs.
